name: PFLAG San Francisco
description: Free family support meetings, education, and advocacy resources
fullDescription: PFLAG San Francisco provides support, education, and advocacy for LGBTQ+ individuals and their families, with regular support meetings and community resources.
whatTheyOffer:
- Monthly virtual support group (2nd Tuesday, 7-9 PM) for parents, caregivers, LGBTQ+ people, and allies
- Family support and education on gender identity and sexual orientation
- One-on-one connection through "Talk Over Coffee"
- Speaker series with nationally recognized experts
- Community advocacy and events
howToGetIt:
1. Visit pflagsf.org for meeting details
2. Join the monthly virtual support meeting
3. Contact PFLAG SF for one-on-one support
4. Access online resources
keywords: PFLAG, San Francisco, LGBTQ, gay, lesbian, trans, queer, family support, parents, support group, advocacy, coming out
